name: qfd_coll_face_s0_regional7_fb-s0r7f-COMMIT
purpose: QDIE5-HC 10-22: qfd_coll_face_s0_regional5_main kit unchanged (source a26cf3ccc, geometry, 12 roots, landing/release hooks) except the supported route.cts_sink TritonCTS setting {"size": 20, "diameter_um": 50, "extra": "-sink_clustering_levels 2 -distance_between_buffers 60 -balance_levels"} (explicit small register clusters, buffers every <= 40-60 um on long leaf nets, balanced levels). Cause: S0 regional5 MAIN 128.4 ps (regional6 unclustered 259.1) cal_ck boundary pin-flop spread > 80 ps at TT: 554 W-edge boundary sinks over ~1 mm hung on long unbuffered leaf nets / unequal levels. No RTL/SDC/pin/threshold change; a geometric equal-stage cal_ck tree (n38 C7 method) would need ref_tile support for multiple_cts_roots (pre_cts_extra refused by the tool).
